Definition: to grave, by implication, to write (describe, inscribe, prescribe, subscribe)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to write, record, enrol; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to write, inscribe, engrave, write in, write on; 1a2) to write down, describe in writing; 1a3) to register, enrol, record; 1a4) to decree; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to be written; 1b2) to be written down, be recorded, be enrolled; 1c) (Piel) to continue writing
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
